{{Quote|Excuse the mess. Lost most of my unit to an army of crazed aliens. We're all that's left of Operations Group Three.|Colonel Grang|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Grang''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Grang headed [[Special Operations Group Three]], which remained behind in the [[Maximum Security Section]] to sow chaos and clear the way while [[Special Operations Group One|Groups One]] and [[Special Operations Group Two|Two]] continued onward in search of the [[Dread Masters]]. However, Grang's men broke open the vaults containing the [[Esh-kha]] in [[the Tomb]], and thus were overrun and nearly wiped out. Grang and the remainder of the group retreated to the [[Imperial frontline camp]], where he recruited other Imperials to strike back at the Esh-kha.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colonel Grang appears on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he provides Imperial players with the mission "Erasing the Esh-kha" and is involved in "Key to the Vaults".<ref name="TOR" />
